# Dynatrace to Present at Upcoming Investor Conferences


July 27, 2026 8:00 am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_9ffac748bd6d76e21b7421bc8d63d867/dynatrace/news/2026-07-27_Dynatrace_to_Present_at_Upcoming_Investor_431.pdf)


BOSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Dynatrace](https://www.dynatrace.com/) (NYSE: DT), the leading AI-powered observability platform, today announced that its executives will present at the following investor conferences:


- KeyBanc Capital Markets Technology Leadership Forum on Monday, August 10 at 11:00 a.m. ET.
- Goldman Sachs Communacopia & Technology Conference on Wednesday, September 9 at 11:10 a.m. ET.


The webcasts will also be accessible on the Investor Relations section of the Dynatrace website,[http://ir.dynatrace.com](http://ir.dynatrace.com/) , and archived for 30 days.


**About Dynatrace**[Dynatrace](https://www.dynatrace.com/) (NYSE: DT) is advancing observability for today’s digital businesses, helping to transform the complexity of modern digital ecosystems into powerful business assets. By leveraging AI-powered insights, Dynatrace enables organizations to analyze, automate, and innovate faster to drive their business forward. To learn more about Dynatrace, visit[www.dynatrace.com](http://www.dynatrace.com/) , visit our blog and follow us on LinkedIn and X @dynatrace.
